author: Parsifal-2045
body:
#### PR description:

This PR switches the models used for the final track selection of the CA (Extended and Vector-Hits-based) to the retrained versions, taking into account the Pixel CPE bug fix in #52174. I also take the occasion to update the retraining tools to match these latest retraining results.

#### PR validation:

The actual reconstruction code changes just switch model files and thresholds.
Comparison plots for:
- 1000 TTbar 200 PU events ([link](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/HPRetraining/MTV_TTbar_noFitCorrections/))
- 1000 high pT QCD 200 PU events ([link)](https://lferragi.web.cern.ch/plots/tracking_phase2/itaca/HPRetraining/MTV_QCD_noFitCorrections/)

Note this PR needs to be tested (and merged) with https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTracker-FinalTrackSelectors/pull/17
title: Retrain PixelTracks High-Purity models
